description.value: Sport Chek is one of Canada's largest sporting goods retail chains, operated by Canadian Tire, carrying a broad range of athletic clothing, footwear, and equipment. This Vancouver Broadway location sits at Broadway and Ontario Street in a well-trafficked urban area. Touring cyclists may find helmets, cycling apparel, hydration gear, and basic accessories, though it is not a dedicated bike shop.
